item.content:encoded:
He's not Nobody quite yet, but he will be. In due time.

The nickname Nemo is a double pun. The obvious meaning is that Nemo = No One, and so he'll eventually become Nobody. The far more oblique one goes like this: Nemo is the name of a character in the Pixar movie Finding Nemo > Said character is a fish > Nobody was originally named Foo, or FO0 > Said character of Foo was used as a persona by a former forum member named Fishmonger, known commonly as Fish.

The second pun was unintentional, which makes it even better.

+  For those who want the easy way
- have some implications

This is the birth of Foundation Classic (something I will expand upon in the future), with the simultaneous discovery of 173 and Site-19 (now 001-ARC). Everyone mentioned in this story is part of the senior staff: Francis is Clef (before he is Clef), Jack is Bright (before he's immortal), Agatha is Rights, Connor is Gears, Adam is Kain pre-dogification, Dmitri is Strenilkov (before he sorta loses it) John is Yoric, Ben is Kondraki, Nemo is Nobody (I would have made him Fish, but that was most likely a really bad idea), and Fats is A Fat Ghost. That's ten of the twelve O5s (e: in this particular universe).

For those who enjoyed this, I can safely say that Francis and company will be returning in the future.
